fields.features_heading: What the Form Does With Each New Lead
fields.features_subheading: A lead capture form trades an offer for contact details. These six parts decide where each lead lands and who hears about it.
fields.feature_1:
Questions that decide who follows up

Asks what a rep needs before the first call: the service wanted, the ZIP code, the budget, or the timeline to buy. Every answer is stored as a field that the routing rules can read.
fields.feature_2:
Each lead routed by a rule you write

Sends each lead where a rule says, such as a branch queue picked by ZIP code or the rep who owns accounts over 100 employees. Whoever acts next gets an alert by Slack or email.
fields.feature_3:
Each lead saved with where it came from

Stores each submission as a row in a database you own, with the page it came from, the campaign tag, and the time. Marketing can count leads by source without exporting anything.
fields.feature_4:
Contacts created in HubSpot or your CRM

Connects to HubSpot or any other CRM with an API and creates the contact as soon as a lead submits. Reps keep working in the CRM they know, and the form keeps its own copy.
fields.feature_5:
One question per screen on a phone

Shows one question per screen for visitors who arrive on a phone from a social post. Ask for the email first and save answers as they come: a form left halfway still yields a lead.
fields.feature_6:
The form and its rules in your GitHub

Exports the full code of the form, its scoring rules, and the lead database to your GitHub repository on paid plans. A developer can change any routing rule in a pull request.

fields.usecase_heading: What Happens After Each Lead Hits Submit
fields.tab_content_1:
A no-heat request goes to the on-call dispatcher

Furrowfield Heating and Air runs a North and a South branch. Homeowners give a ZIP code and the problem on one website form. A request marked No heat goes to Dale Wexford, the on-call dispatcher, in a Slack direct message with the address and phone. Tune-ups wait in the queue of the branch that serves that ZIP.
fields.tab_content_2:
Leads at 60 points or more reach an account executive

Paystitch scores each lead from its payroll software pricing page on company size, start date, and job title. Corbin Thayer scored 72 with 120 employees. At 60 points or more, the lead becomes a HubSpot contact and account executive Mira Ostrand gets a Slack message. Leads under 60 get the monthly newsletter.
fields.tab_content_3:
Two guides in 30 days put the lead on an advisor's list

Quillmere Wealth puts its retirement guides behind a short form: name, email, and planned retirement year. Each guide goes out by email as soon as the form is sent. When the same email asks for a second guide within 30 days, the lead is marked warm and advisor Priya Halvorsen gets an email adding it to her call list.
fields.tab_content_4:
All 11 hot booth leads get an email the next morning

Torvane Robotics reps logged booth visitors on their phones at a packaging trade show, with a hot, warm, or cold rating for each. By closing day the form held 64 leads, 11 of them rated hot. Each hot lead got a follow-up email from its rep the next morning, and the rest went to the marketing list.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Lead Capture Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a lead capture form that asks only what sales needs and routes each lead, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Pick the one offer the form trades
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 List what the first call needs
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Write the routing rule as a sentence
fields.howto_step_1_des: Decide what the visitor gets for their details, such as an estimate or a guide. One offer per form keeps the follow-up obvious, and the thank-you message can promise exactly that thing and say when it arrives. A second offer gets its own form.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Write down the questions a rep asks in the first two minutes of a call, and keep only those on the form. Name and email are fixed. Add one or two qualifiers, such as company size or ZIP code, that change who follows up.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Say who gets which lead the way you would brief a new hire: requests from ZIP codes east of the river go to the East office, and anything marked urgent goes to whoever is on call. Name a backup person for days off.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Paste the fields and the routing rule into one prompt, along with the follow-up you want. Emergent builds the form with its lead database and alerts. Change any piece later by asking, such as raising the score threshold or adding a field for the referral source.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Connect the CRM sales already uses
fields.howto_step_5_des: If sales works in HubSpot or another CRM with an API, connect it, and each new lead becomes a contact there. Map every form field to a CRM property before the first live lead arrives, and the reports will line up from day one.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Draft the email each lead gets after submitting, with the offer attached or linked. The FTC's CAN-SPAM guide says a marketing email must include a clear and conspicuous explanation of how the recipient can opt out. Put the unsubscribe link in the footer.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Fill in the form five times with answers that should route differently, including one that matches no rule. Check that each lead lands in the database, reaches the right person, and gets the right email. Delete the test rows before you share the link.

faq_plan.a: A lead capture form is a web form that asks a visitor for contact details, such as a name and email, in exchange for something they want: an estimate or a call with sales. Each submission becomes a lead that someone follows up. It is also known as a lead generation form.

faq_plan.q: How can I create a lead form?
faq_plan.ref: How can I create a lead form?

prov.original: How can I create a lead form?

faq_plan.a: Pick one offer, choose the few fields a rep needs, and decide who gets each lead. Then describe all three to Emergent's AI form builder, which builds the form, the database behind it, and the alerts. Share it as a link or embed it on your site.

faq_plan.q: Can you give me an example of a lead form?
faq_plan.ref: Can you give me an example of a lead form?

prov.original: Can you give me an example of a lead form?

faq_plan.a: Yes. A landscaping company might ask for a name, phone, street address, the service wanted (weekly mowing or a spring cleanup), and the best time to call. Any lead capture form template gives a similar start. Cut every field the crew would not use on the first call.

faq_plan.q: How do I add lead capture forms to a real estate website?
faq_plan.ref: how to add lead capture forms to real estate website
faq_plan.a: Place a short form on each listing page that asks for a showing time, and a home value form on its own page for sellers. Tag each lead with the listing it came from, and the agent sees which home drew the inquiry. For a building still under construction, an interest form collects buyers before units are priced.

faq_plan.q: How many fields should lead capture forms have?
faq_plan.ref: how to create lead capture forms
faq_plan.a: As few as the first call needs: contact details plus one or two questions that tell sales who should call. Every extra required field is one more reason to close the tab. Ask for budget on the call instead, or in a second step after the lead is saved.

faq_plan.q: Can I create multiple lead capture forms?
faq_plan.ref: can i create multiple lead capture forms in 17hats
faq_plan.a: Yes. Build one per offer, such as one for pricing and one for a guide, and point them all at one lead database. A field that records which form each lead came from lets marketing compare forms side by side. Emergent's free tier covers building and publishing a lead capture form, with no cap on responses.

faq_plan.q: Does a church need a lead capture form?
faq_plan.ref: does planning center include a lead capture form
faq_plan.a: Yes, if it wants to follow up with first-time visitors. A short connect card on the website can take contact details and ask whether the visitor would like a call from a pastor. Print a QR code to it in the bulletin. For a retreat or class with a set number of places, use a sign up form instead.

faq_plan.q: How can I add lead capture forms to my website?
faq_plan.ref: how can i add lead capture forms to my website
faq_plan.a: Embed the form with the snippet your form tool provides, or link a button to the form's own URL. Put it where visitors decide: beside pricing, at the end of each service page, and in the footer. Add a hidden field for the page address, and every lead records where it came in. Leads from a form Emergent builds land in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: How do I add a lead capture form to a social media profile?
faq_plan.ref: how do add a lead capture form to intagram
faq_plan.a: Publish the form at its own link and put that link in the profile's bio. Visitors arrive on a phone; keep the form to two or three fields. Add a hidden source field set to the channel name, and leads from the profile show up apart from website traffic.

faq_plan.q: How do you add a lead capture form to a landing page?
faq_plan.ref: how do you add a lead capture form to instagra
faq_plan.a: Put the form near the top of a page built for one offer, under a headline that names what the visitor gets. Remove the site menu: the form should be the only next step. Emergent can build the form and a lead generation landing page around it from one prompt.

plan.angle: The top 10 splits into template galleries (Jotform), form products (HubSpot, Pipedrive, leadcapture.io) and field-count guides (Mailchimp, Unbounce, PlatoForms, Clearbit examples). Each stops at the submit button. This page shows what a lead capture form does in the minutes after a submit, in four businesses a searcher will recognize: a heating company that routes no-heat requests to the on-call dispatcher, a payroll software company that scores leads and sends the high scorers to an account executive, a wealth firm that flags a second guide download for an advisor, and a robotics maker capturing booth leads on phones at a trade show. The FAQ answers the definition, an example, field counts, real estate sites, church visitor follow-up and social profiles.
